title: Overtime
description: This project adds a system similar to the movie In Time. It is a minigame where all players spawn with 5 minutes on the clock, and killing players steals time from each other. The last player standing wins.
body:
This plugin is a minigame called Overtime.
Inspired by the move "In Time".

If you haven't watched the movie: Everybody has a timer, and when their timer runs out, they die. In this plugin, it works similarly. Everybody starts with 5 minutes, and they lose time as the match goes on. Whoever stands the longest wins.

The top 5 players are displayed on the scoreboard. If you lose enough time, you go into the negatives, where you get Wither II, and take an additional 1 damage per second, making it a total of 1 heart per second of Overtime.

There is a custom map for this plugin, which isn't required to play it, but highly recommended, as the plugin will be buggy and will teleport players weirdly without it.
The map is avaliable here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mAw_EmNP_wsmjfXYRWsCYscFutvSWI1b/view?usp=sharing
The demo video is avaliable here: https://youtu.be/wzoEzaXqHkA

What the map does: There are chests scattered around the map with various loot. It also garuntees a good place to spawn, where there is plenty of space to roam, and there is a glass platform to spawn on.
